description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class 'AccessStrategy' within the OrangeHRM system, specifically in the Maintenance plugin. It provides a base for implementing different access strategies, including parameter management, entity class handling, match criteria, maintenance service integration, and data formatting. The class includes abstract methods and concrete utility methods for interacting with employee data and formatting values.

classes.name: AccessStrategy
classes.description: An abstract class that defines the contract and common functionality for different strategies to access or manage employee-related data within the OrangeHRM maintenance module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the access strategy with an entity class name and optional configuration array, setting match criteria and parameters.

methods.name: getParameters
methods.description: Returns the set parameters for the access strategy.

methods.name: setParameters
methods.description: Sets the parameters used for the access strategy.

methods.name: getEntityClassName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the entity class associated with this strategy.

methods.name: setEntityClassName
methods.description: Sets the entity class name for the strategy.

methods.name: getMatchBy
methods.description: Returns the array of match criteria used to locate entities.

methods.name: getMaintenanceService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and retrieves the MaintenanceService instance used for data operations.

methods.name: getMatchByValues
methods.description: Generates an array of match values based on an employee number, incorporating join criteria if present.

methods.name: getEntityRecords
methods.description: Uses the maintenance service to extract data records matching certain criteria from a specified table.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Dynamically loads a formatter class and uses it to format a given current value.

methods.name: addRecordsToArray
methods.description: Constructs an associative array of data fields by retrieving and optionally formatting values from an access entity.
